mapper.select: SELECT x.id AS "id", x.owner_id AS "ownerId", c.name AS "name" FROM crm_customer x JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = x.customer_id WHERE x.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(x.last_follow_time, x.claim_time, x.create_time) < #{since} AND x.stage <> 'DEAL'
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer SET owner_id = NULL, dept_id = NULL, claim_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
